logic.regime: closed 4H close>EMA50, EMA20>EMA50, EMA20 5-bar slope>0 for long; exact inverse short
logic.liquidity_sweep: most recent intact confirmed 2L/2R swing within 72 bars; sweep penetration 0.05-1.0 ATR and close back inside
logic.displacement: within 3 bars: range>=1.5 ATR14, body/range>=0.6, directional CLV, AND close breaks pre-sweep 5-bar structure (MSS)
logic.fvg: 3-candle FVG >= 0.15 ATR14 on displacement bar or within next 2 bars
logic.retest: FVG midpoint limit entry on first valid touch within 8 bars without close through far edge; 4H regime rechecked
logic.confirmation: MSS is embedded in displacement; no extra post-retest chase confirmation
logic.stop: sweep extreme +/- 0.15 ATR14 measured on sweep bar
logic.management: TP1 1.5R on 50%, remainder stop->BE; TP2 3.0R exits rest
logic.ambiguity: same 1H bar stop checked before targets, including retest/entry bar

costs.implementation: charged once per fill via combined cost

logic.positioning: fixed 1R reference risk per trade; one open position per symbol
